useCases.title: Write a product launch kit from your brief
useCases.message: Help me put together a launch kit for a new product or feature. Ask me where the product brief lives: a Notion page or Google Doc. Then read it and write the full kit: press release, social posts, and a launch email. Ask me where to save each piece when it's ready.
